item.title: Monroe County FFA Stockman team places in the top third at regional Block and Bridle competition
item.description: Monroe County, WV (WOAY) The Monroe County FFA Stockman’s team is celebrating a strong finish at a major regional competition. item.title: Kanawha County Sheriffs searching for suspect in Saint Albans shooting
item.description: Kanawha County Sheriffs are investigating a shooting that took place in Saint Albans. According to a media release, Kanawha County deputies responded to a reported shooting on February 23 at approximately 9:11 p.m. in the 12000 block of Coal River Road in Saint Albans. Upon arrival, deputies discovered a man suffering from a gunshot wound to the face. #KanawhaCounty #WOAY
